channel.title: Pitaka Blog
channel.description: Practical budgeting and personal finance guides from Pitaka.

item.title: How to Create a Budget That Fits Your Month
item.description: Build a monthly budget from your income, bills, and everyday spending, with a worked Philippine peso example and a simple review routine.

item.title: Seven Ways to Review Your Savings Plan
item.description: Review your cash flow, recurring costs, and savings goals without relying on guaranteed savings claims or a one-size-fits-all target.

item.title: How to Track Spending Across Cash, Banks, and E-Wallets
item.description: Keep a manual record of spending across cash, bank accounts, and e-wallets, reconcile balances, and avoid counting transfers twice.

item.title: Investment Records: Risk, Fees, and Diversification
item.description: Understand the limits of an investment tracker and what to check about risk, fees, diversification, and the accuracy of your records.

item.title: Emergency Funds: Set a Goal and Track Your Reserve
item.description: Separate unexpected expenses from planned bills, choose a reserve target that fits your circumstances, and track contributions and withdrawals.

item.title: How to Budget With Irregular Income Without Falling Behind
item.description: A practical budgeting system for freelancers, commission earners, and anyone whose paycheck changes month to month.

item.title: Sinking Funds for Beginners: What They Are and How to Start
item.description: Learn how sinking funds work, which categories to set up first, and how they reduce budget stress month after month.

item.title: How to Track Shared Expenses With Your Partner Without the Drama
item.description: A practical system for splitting rent, groceries, and household spending while keeping expectations clear and resentment low.

item.title: Budgeting With Multiple Bank Accounts: A Simple System That Still Works
item.description: Use multiple bank accounts without losing control by assigning each account a job and tracking transfers intentionally.
